denominatorRules: errors/incomplete stay in the denominator; never removed (MVP 10)

attempt policy, repetition count, case order
metrics: bundle_repair_success = verified fixable bundles / scheduled eligible fixable scenarios
target_repair_success = fixed targets / eligible impacted targets (never replaces scenario count)
unsafe_assurance = incorrect positive target/bundle claims / all positive claims, split by level
safe_abstention = correct unsupported/ambiguous handling / scheduled unsupported/ambiguous cases
no_impact_false_alarm = unnecessary migration patches / control cases
coverage = verified required targets/edges/invariants / required scope; unknowns shown separately
reproduction = successful independent reproductions / scheduled reproductions
native_certification = passed capability records / required records, with matrix version
organic_benefit = recovered owner-approved workflows / affected pilot workflows (+ adoption, human effort)
efficiency = actual calls/tokens/cost/CPU/memory/wall time per arm and complexity class; p50/p95 + n
time_to_first_actionable = active user time repo-connect -> evidence-backed diagnosis/blocker/verified result
cost_per_accepted_repair = gross cost of ALL investigations incl. failed/incomplete/proof/repro / verified bundles accepted by owners; net-after-credits and review minutes separate
forecast_accuracy = estimated cost-duration components/ranges vs actual on same plan/profile; cold/warm and queue separated
pairedComparisonRules: equal budget/case allocation for paired comparisons; extra exploration labeled separately
report paired outcomes, unsafe claims, required-coverage misses, actual cost/time/review effort
better-or-indistinguishable B2 is still reported; no suppression of baseline wins
three ablation differences are NEVER summed into a total causal contribution; report interactions/limitations
analysisPlan.revisionRule: any change to model, prompt, fixture, budget, or policy ends this plan and opens a new evaluation version; historical results are never rewritten
